terms: Annual edition: one printed edition per year (Pinoy Pages 2026–2027: released spring, April 16 2027, valid through summer and fall until the next edition); the website is updated year-round.
Term: every paid choice (Featured, Half-page ad, Full-page ad, and the Starter QR add-on) is a 12-month listing that renews with each annual edition. Free listings stay free.
Founding price: available on orders paid by the early-bird date of the first edition you join.
Founding price lock (firm rule): advertisers who renew on time keep their founding price for every annual edition.
Renewing on time means paying by the next edition's early-bird date (December 18 each year). Renewal reminders go out in November.

Member renewal discount: existing paid members who renew by the on-time date (December 18) get a flat 20% off their locked price for the next edition (e.g. Featured $299 becomes $239). Existing members only; not available to new sign-ups. It does not stack with any other discount and does not compound year over year: it is always 20% off the locked price, valid for one renewal year, and reviewed each edition. Offered in renewal outreach with your year-end scan and click summary.
Late renewal: renewals after the on-time date are charged the current regular price and lose the founding lock and member discount.
Website mirror: your online presence mirrors your print presence and is included free in every tier; there is never a separate charge for it.
No guarantee of results: we report scan and click counts monthly (Starter and up). We do not promise any number of leads, calls, sales or visitors.

Printed guide: a short-run proof copy for advertisers and a sales brochure for prospects. It is not sold or handed out to the public. The print run goes ahead only once ads are paid by the ad-close date; if it does not print, ad fees for print are refunded.
Prices are in CAD, plus HST. Draft terms, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
